rationale: Sub-classifier A halts because setting rate_limit to 0 on a live production API gateway has high severity (complete removal of throttling exposes the system to abuse/DoS, severity=4) and broad blast radius (all API consumers affected, blast_radius=4); Sub-classifier B fires on mutates_persistent_state (SSM parameter is immediately and persistently overwritten) and no_rollback_procedure (no automatic revert mechanism exists — a manual corrective put-parameter would be required, but damage from unthrottled traffic in the interim cannot be undone).
